query: What different themes do students raise in these open responses?

per_column.name: theme_engagement
per_column.rationale: Binary theme flag gives a groupable axis directly answering the query. Grounded: ED-0002 mentions engagement dipping/showing up, correctly 1; ED-0001 no engagement mention, 0.

per_column.name: theme_technical_issues
per_column.rationale: Useful theme axis. Well grounded on ED-0001 (camera freezes) and ED-0003 (logs out). However ED-0005 flags 1 with no technical mention (cameras off is student behavior, not a tech failure), a likely misread.

per_column.name: theme_social_interaction
per_column.rationale: Strong groupable theme. ED-0003 zero peer interaction, ED-0005 no participation, ED-0001 miss raising hand all correctly 1.

per_column.name: theme_hands_on_learning
per_column.rationale: Useful axis. ED-0002 kitchen-chemistry labs correct. ED-0004 documentary clips flagged hands_on is a slight stretch but defensible.

per_column.name: theme_teacher_effectiveness
per_column.rationale: Useful but near-majority (181/250) and noisiest. ED-0003 flags teacher_effectiveness (teacher can't tell she's lost) is defensible; ED-0004 correct. Prevalence suggests over-application.

per_column.name: theme_asynchronous_benefits
per_column.rationale: Distinct valuable theme. ED-0004 pause/self-pace recorded lectures correctly 1; silent rows 0.

per_column.name: theme_equity_concerns
per_column.rationale: Meaningful theme axis. No positive samples to verify directly, but silent rows correctly 0 and plausible reads.

per_column.name: theme_attention_focus
per_column.rationale: Very sparse (8/250), near-constant so limited analytical leverage, but grounded on silent rows as 0.

per_column.name: detected_themes
per_column.rationale: Aggregated multi-label string directly answers 'what themes' with co-occurrence patterns; strong leverage. Values consistent with per-theme flags and source text, inheriting minor over-flagging noise.

judge.rationale: The added columns constitute a coherent thematic coding scheme that directly serves the query about themes students raise, offering multiple groupable axes plus an aggregate multi-label column for co-occurrence analysis. Values are largely sound readings of the source text, with silent rows correctly set to 0. Minor groundedness issues appear in over-application of technical_issues (ED-0005) and the very high prevalence of teacher_effectiveness, suggesting some liberal flagging. theme_attention_focus is nearly constant and adds little leverage, but that alone does not sink the set. Overall the columns meet both necessary conditions well.
